# coffee_capsule_carton — realism QA

Status: **needs_further_repair**. Grades: evidence B, silhouette C, proportions B, colour_texture C, material B, articulation B, physics B, collision A, instances C, cross_view F. Primary visible IoU: 0.636.

Evidence: f3043, f3039, f3021. Camera intrinsics and metric transforms: `../review/calibration.json`. Comparison: `../review/coffee_capsule_carton_compare.jpg`. Per-frame dimensions, IoU, histogram and mask provenance: `../qa_report.json`.

Changes:
- Added explicit physical schema, material-specific friction, restitution, COM/fragility and honest mass/density priors.
- Updated reproducible meshes, GLB/Blend, collision pieces and calibrated-instance transforms.
- Computed part COM estimates from collision volume; corrected Blender inertial origins without moving canonical visuals.
- Added missing inclined orange carton and three middle-shelf cartons (6 -> 10).
- Shared row orientations for clipped left boxes; shared mesh and distinct photo variants.

Remaining:
- At least one reviewed instance/view remains below 0.75 silhouette IoU; primary-view fit does not certify all instances.
- Visible silhouette/occlusion mismatch remains; inspect calibrated overlay before training use.
- Photometric mismatch remains: illumination, baked label lighting and/or reflective/transmissive appearance need further calibration.
- Clipped left and middle-shelf end faces use same-product width priors; placement/depth and side appearance still require review.
- Mass, COM, friction and restitution are unmeasured priors.
- No directly observed manipulation sequence verifies closure forces, thread pitch, flap limits or stiffness.
